digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 15 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: obra/superpowers
repos.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI 编码 Agent 按成熟软件工程方法论工作的技能框架，把开发流程沉淀为可复用技能

repos.name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
repos.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
repos.summary_zh: 单文件 CLAUDE.md 直击 LLM 编码常见陷阱，让 Claude Code 少犯 Karpathy 总结的典型错误

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用模块化能力扩展

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
repos.summary_zh: GitHub 官方出品的 SDD 规范驱动开发入门工具包，帮开发者快速落地结构化开发流程

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EM
repos.summary_zh: 一站式 Python 网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全搞定

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的多线程 Redis/Valkey 平替，兼容现有协议并内置全文与向量搜索

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 将康熙部首等形近CJK字形折叠归一，解决PDF提取文本因字形变体导致匹配失败的问题

repos.name: l-wn/ClusterChat
repos.description: A chatbot, with a large language model split across its users, entirely in the browser.
repos.summary_zh: 把大模型拆分到多个用户浏览器中协同推理的分布式聊天机器人，无需服务器即可运行

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant
repos.summary_zh: 为 AI Agent 提供跨会话持久记忆，自动捕获会话内容并用 AI 压缩，再将相关上下文注入未来会话

repos.name: tashfeenahmed/freellmapi
repos.description: 7.4 billion tokens per month. 34 free LLM providers. 635 free model endpoints. All behind one /v1 endpoint, plus any custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint
repos.summary_zh: 聚合34家免费LLM供应商共635个模型端点于单一/v1接口，支持智能路由与自动故障转移，月供74亿Token

repos.name: wici-ai/inferssd
repos.description: Run models larger than your RAM or VRAM by streaming MoE experts from SSD. Built on llama.cpp.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 llama.cpp 从 SSD 流式加载 MoE 专家，让超出内存或显存的模型也能跑推理

repos.name: T-Crypt/berth
repos.description: Berth is a lightweight GPU resource manager written in Go. It controls which applications get access to your GPU, when they get it, and how that acces
repos.summary_zh: 用 Go 写的轻量 GPU 资源管理器，按需调度应用访问 GPU 并控制交接时机，让多任务共享显卡不再抢资源

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: ninetyhe-90/training-explore
repos.description: Interactive explorer for learning how large language models are trained
repos.summary_zh: 交互式探索大语言模型训练全流程的教学工具，用可视化方式让抽象的训练原理变得直观易懂

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署为校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可用的决策引擎

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: janhq/jan
repos.description: Jan is an open source alternative to ChatGPT that runs 100% offline on your computer.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线运行在本地电脑的开源 ChatGPT 替代品，兼顾隐私与便捷

repos.name: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
repos.description: Project NOMAD is an offline-first knowledge and education server. Wikipedia, thousands of books, courses, maps, and optional local AI, all running on
repos.summary_zh: 离线优先的知识教育服务器，把维基百科、数千书籍课程地图和可选本地AI装进自有硬件，断网也能用

repos.name: cjpais/Handy
repos.description: A free, open source, and extensible speech-to-text application that works completely offline.
repos.summary_zh: 完全离线运行的免费开源语音转文字应用，用 Rust 打造且支持扩展，兼顾隐私与性能

repos.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的AI水印清除工具，帮你移除自有内容中的AI水印，已获2.6万星

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: openclaw/openclaw
repos.description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: 跨平台 AI 智能体框架，能在任意操作系统上真正执行任务而非只聊天，以龙虾式独特方式落地自动化

repos.name: denoland/deno
repos.description: A modern runtime for JavaScript and TypeScript.
repos.summary_zh: 原生支持 TypeScript 且默认安全的现代 JS 运行时，用 Rust 打造，免配置直接跑

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，用 Rust 实现，让编码快到思维速度

repos.name: remotion-dev/remotion
repos.description: 🎥 Make videos programmatically with React
repos.summary_zh: 用 React 组件像写网页一样编程生成视频，让开发者以熟悉的声明式方式实现视频自动化制作
